name: Alex Moon
originStory: You were born to Elena Moon and Thomas Moon, married six years by the time you arrived. She was a dentist, he was a surgeon. Two cars, a house with a garden, and holidays that involved aeroplanes. You were the second child. Marcus came first and never let you forget it. Your grandfather Daniel read to you every week from books far too old for you. In Amsterdam, in 2026. Nobody there had any idea what you would become.

timeline.text: Born in Amsterdam to Elena Moon and Thomas Moon — a well off household.

productions.title: Paper Cousin
productions.premise: A daughter who stayed away too long comes back to a terrace due for clearance. A will leaves everything to one of them, and it is too late to be fair about it.
